'''Dennis Jeffris WYS with Palace Raiders but not Lewis's''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Dennis Jeffris]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15111">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15111 WYS with Palace Raiders  but not Lewis's], DeckTech (Dennis "Denethor" Jeffris, 8 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15111/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15111/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dennis Jeffris]]
* '''Published:''' 8 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''WYS with Palace Raiders  but not Lewis's''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 WYS Jeffris LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Here's a deck that is kind of like Lewis's WYS (which is excellent, I love it) but using a few of my own strategies.

== Original post ==

'''WYS with Palace Raiders  but not Lewis's'''
* '''Author:''' Dennis "Denethor" Jeffris
* '''Published:''' April 8, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Here's a deck that is kind of like Lewis's WYS (which is excellent, I love it) but using a few of my own strategies.

=== Strategy ===

Well, basically play this like Lewis's WYS except it's more heavily weighed on Harvest.  I don't expect points for originality, but this deck is awesome, and I think the changes I made are for the better.
